name: manual_24607c
claim: Before reusing a head-specific review verdict, fetch the live PR head: an operator-run online remediation session can push to several PRs at once without a board post, and every review taken at an older head is then stale evidence.

decisions.notes: Observed 2026-10-24: one online CodeRabbit and Greptile remediation session moved five PR heads across three repos after the reviews and an agent synthesis were taken. Re-verify at the new heads, check cross-repo pins and probe byte-identity, and fetch before any push.
